## Claim

From 64 to 16,384 points, the RMS error of the lab's Monte Carlo estimate of pi falls as one over the square root of the number of points (`R-2`).

## Licensed by

- `R-2`: the fitted log-log slope of the RMS error, from one locked run.

## Bounds that travel with it

One estimator, Python's standard generator, and five sample sizes from 64 to 16,384 points, each four times the last. One run of 100 seeds per size.

## Must not be said

- That every Monte Carlo estimate converges at this rate. Only this estimator was run.
- That the error at a given size is known to within 10%. The scaled error left that band in one arm of the [protocol](/content/protocols/pi-error-scaling.md).
- That the estimate is unbiased. The mean estimate at the largest size was not within the predicted distance of pi, and no result measures the bias.
